data_points.source_name: MFDS 2024 quasi-drug production statistics, via Medifonews
data_points.notes: PRODUCTION VALUE, not retail. In Korea toothpaste is regulated as a 의약외품 (quasi-drug), not a cosmetic, so it sits in MFDS quasi-drug statistics rather than the cosmetics production table. 치약제 (dentifrice) production was KRW 4,051억 in 2024 (= KRW 405.1bn; USD 274.0mn @ 1478.40 USD/KRW pinned 2026-07-21), a 25.3% share and the largest of all quasi-drug product groups; total 의약외품 production was KRW 1조 6,037억. SCOPE CAVEAT: 치약제 is toothpaste/dentifrice ONLY — it excludes toothbrushes, mouthwash (a separate 구중청량제 quasi-drug group), floss and whitening devices, so it is well short of a full oral-care segment. Domestic manufacture only, excludes imports. Confidence MEDIUM not HIGH: figures are MFDS's but were read off Korean pharma trade press; the MFDS statistical yearbook page (index.go.kr idx_cd=3059) renders its tables via JS and returned no numbers when fetched, so the government table itself is not verified. cf IMARC's toothpaste-segment estimate of ~USD 410mn for 2024 (relayed by Daxue) — ~1.5x the MFDS production figure, consistent with a retail-vs-production basis difference plus imports, NOT a conflict; do not compare directly (rule 11).

data_points.source_name: Grand View Research, relayed by Daxue Consulting
data_points.notes: 'In 2024, South Korea's oral care market stood at USD 975.9 million', attributed on the fetched Daxue page to Grand View Research. Grand View's own South Korea oral care horizon page (grandviewresearch.com/horizon/outlook/oral-care-market/south-korea) returns HTTP 403 and could NOT be fetched, so it is not cited — the Daxue page, which was fetched, is the citation and Grand View is named as the underlying source. cf Deep Market Insights USD 892.82mn for 2025 — a LATER year at a LOWER level, so the two are ~1.19x apart once growth is allowed for; definitional mismatch unresolved, do not average. Channel coverage, organised/unorganised split and duty-free treatment not stated.

data_points.source_name: Grand View Research, relayed by Daxue Consulting
data_points.notes: 'By 2030, the oral care market in Korea is expected to reach USD 1.5 billion, growing at a compound annual growth rate of 6.9% from 2025 to 2030', attributed to Grand View Research on the fetched Daxue page. Trajectory roughly consistent (975.9 x 1.069^6 = 1,455mn vs the 1.5bn stated). cf Deep Market Insights 6.41% (2026-2034); the two aggregators agree on pace to within ~0.5pp even though they disagree on level.

'the Korea Oral Care Market stood at USD 892.82 Million in 2025.' cf Grand View (via Daxue) USD 975.9mn for 2024 — the earlier year carries the higher level, implying a ~1.19x gap once 2024-25 growth is allowed for; definitional mismatch unresolved, do not average. Basis assumed retail sell-through; the page does not state basis, channel coverage or duty-free treatment. NOTE: a search snippet circulated USD 561.15mn (2024) for this same publisher; the page as actually fetched on 2026-07-25 states USD 892.82mn (2025), and only the fetched value is recorded.

'The Korea market is expected to advance at a CAGR of 6.41% from 2026 through 2034', USD 892.82mn (2025) to USD 1,556.15mn (2034). Trajectory internally consistent (892.82 x 1.0641^9 = 1,560). cf Grand View (via Daxue) 6.9% for 2025-2030.

data_points.source_name: MFDS quasi-drug production statistics 2023 and 2024, via Medifonews (derived)
data_points.methodology: Computed from two separately fetched Medifonews reports of MFDS quasi-drug production statistics: 치약제 (dentifrice) KRW 4,188억 in 2023 (https://www.medifonews.com/news/article.html?no=192258, fetched 2026-07-25) to KRW 4,051억 in 2024 (https://www.medifonews.com/news/article.html?no=204402, fetched 2026-07-25) = -3.27%. Both are PRODUCTION basis, same MFDS series, same product group, so no normalisation is needed. Internal cross-check: the stated shares reconcile to the stated totals on both years (4,188/16,822 = 24.9% as printed; 4,051/16,037 = 25.3% as printed), which corroborates that the two years are on a like-for-like definition. Sensitivity: none on the arithmetic. Definitional uncertainty is the binding constraint — see notes.
data_points.notes: CONTRARY SIGNAL, flagged deliberately. Korean domestic toothpaste PRODUCTION fell 3.27% in CY2024 while every aggregator on file forecasts Korean oral care growing 6.4-6.9% a year. These are not the same measure (rule 11): production is domestic factory-gate output of dentifrice only, whereas the aggregator figures are retail sell-through across the whole oral-care basket including mouthwash, brushes and imports. A domestic production decline alongside retail growth is consistent with import substitution and/or category mix shifting toward non-dentifrice formats, but that is a hypothesis, not a reconciled result — do NOT publish this as 'the' Korea oral care growth rate. Total quasi-drug production also fell over the same period (KRW 1조 6,822억 to 1조 6,037억).
